messages:
Rhea B: Quick heads-up 1: Zephyr MLH NDA signed. They offered a two-week preview in August and asked if we want them in the cloud marketplace pilot. Link (internal): https://redwood-internal/partnerships/zephyr/nda
Tom S: Nice. Do we have infrastructure details? GPU SKU, interconnect, and whether they support MIG?
Rhea B: Zephyr said: 4xH100 per node, NVLink full mesh, 100GbE fabric. They will provide jumpbox + S3 bucket and an OCI image for marketplace testing. Access window Aug 3-17.
PartnerBot: Created workspace /partnerships/zephyr-preview and checklist template added.
Elena V: For benchmarks propose matrix: Mistral-7B int8, Llama-2-70B fp16, and an embedding throughput test. Metrics: cold-start, warm p50/p95, tokens/sec, mem headroom, and perf per watt (they requested power draw numbers).
Marcus L: We should add correctness checks for int8 outputs vs fp16 baseline. Also a quality delta metric for quantized runs.
Tom S: Ask Zephyr for driver/CUDA versions, BIOS, NVLink topology graph, and any marketplace packaging constraints (OCI manifest, signing).
Rhea B: Will ask. Also check allowed disclosure for marketing and whether they want marketplace listing co-branding. Legal wants to pre-approve any screenshots/figures.
Elena V: Run plan snippet: ```bash
# quick perf
python -m bench.run --model {model} --dtype {dtype} --seq 1024 --batch 1,2,4 --profile --log-env
```
Elena V: We'll capture model sha256, image tag, git hash, and seed for reproducibility.
Marcus L: Fallback: if quantized kernels fail, fallback to Redwood Dedicated for int8 runs and mark "fallback_marketplace" in report. Clear labeling required.
Tom S: Also request sample OCI manifest and signing certs from Zephyr so we can test marketplace ingestion flow. If accepted, we coordinate listing copy with product.
PartnerBot: New task: "Zephyr preview bench + marketplace checklist" assigned to Tom S due 2026-07-25
Rhea B: Timeline: draft plan by Jul 25, request creds by Jul 29, run Aug 3-17, internal review Aug 20, decide marketplace co-listing Aug 25.
Elena V: I'll prepare a 250-prompt eval (PII-free) and route to legal.
Marcus L: I'll add a small container recipe and NCCL tuning notes to the workspace.
Rhea B: Thanks. Tom 1 please ping Zephyr for infra details and manifest. We'll keep discussion in the partner workspace.
